token_semantics.cache_read_tokens: tokens served from the provider prompt cache
token_semantics.cache_write_tokens: tokens written to the provider prompt cache
token_semantics.counted_input_tokens: input tokens summed for totals under the provider's documented accounting rule
token_semantics.counted_output_tokens: output tokens summed for totals under the provider's documented accounting rule
token_semantics.coverage: attempts with known usage versus total attempts; unknown usage is never counted as zero
token_semantics.exclusions: code execution, static analysis, plotting, and YAML validation consume no model tokens
token_semantics.input_tokens: provider-reported request input tokens, including system prompts and other billed request context
token_semantics.total_tokens: provider-reported total when available, otherwise counted input plus counted output
